method: Independent web lookup and direct HTTPS retrieval of governing official specifications, implementation documentation, named public issues, merged patches and their test/caller context. No downloaded code or UI examples executed. No campaign-tree/history search, live candidate inputs, other rubrics, extra graders, subagents or native Goal.
blinding: Imperfect: assigned paths, stage topology and outputs expose control/treatment and method-bearing details. Shared independent research is reused; no cross-arm judgment or timing comparison precedes both original manifests.
rights: Evaluator paraphrases only; no source corpus, native transcript, private identity or token values reproduced. Upstream copyright/license notices remain accessible at each exact public URL. No copied code requiring a separate license artifact.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA 1.2
sources.locator: grid/table; rowcount/rowindex; colcount/colindex; selected/sort; invalid/errormessage; activedescendant
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: Sparse grids require full logical counts and ordered one-based indices, with -1 for unknown totals. Contiguous-column shortcuts have conditions. Error-message references require invalid state and pertinent visible content. Active-descendant ownership and focus-role requirements constrain references. These are web semantics, not native toolkit interoperability guarantees.

sources.title: APG Grid Pattern
sources.locator: Data grids; keyboard interaction; inside-cell navigation
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: An interactive composite has managed focus and one tab-sequence entry. Navigation keys and editor/widget keys require distinct modes. Nonfunctional headers need not receive focus. Control+End with dynamic DOM content can stop at the last loaded row. Neither the pattern nor its examples certifies an arbitrary implementation.

sources.title: APG Keyboard Interface
sources.locator: Persistence of focus; focus versus selection; roving tabindex; active descendant
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: Focus and selection are distinct. Removing the active element requires deliberate focus management. Roving tabindex moves DOM focus; active descendant keeps focus on a supporting container and requires ownership, visual indication and viewport management. Following a deleted list item is one illustrative policy, not a requirement to retarget an active intake edit.

sources.title: APG Grid and Table Properties
sources.locator: row/column count and index; contiguous versus noncontiguous columns
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: Logical row totals include header rows. Missing or inconsistent indices can break assistive-technology reading. Noncontiguous columns require cell-level indices. Correct metadata describes sparse structure; it supplies neither keyboard code nor proof of screen-reader support.

sources.title: APG Data Grid Examples
sources.version_context: Living examples; dated update reported by candidate
sources.locator: Read This First; editable/sortable example; scrolling example
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: The examples expressly require testing before production use. They demonstrate editable cells, keyboard headers and logical positions. Reading an example is not running it, and example metadata does not establish a thousands-record console's interoperability.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: Keyboard functionality, visible focus and detected-error text support the proposals. Known correction suggestions have security/purpose exceptions. Error-prevention criteria have specific submission conditions. Status messages concern changes that do not receive focus. Applicable native product/legal conformance is not established by these web criteria.

sources.title: Understanding Error Identification
sources.locator: Intent; native validation limitations
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: The explanation requires the nature and identity of an error and distinguishes suggestions from identification. It permits different presentation mechanisms and warns about generic or transient native validation messages. It does not prescribe one particular error-summary architecture.

sources.title: Understanding Status Messages
sources.locator: Intent; results content versus status text
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: Search results themselves differ from concise result-count or completion messages. Focus/context changes already convey new context; blindly announcing every background row is unnecessary. Status presentation can use roles, properties or appropriate accessibility API notifications, subject to the criterion's scope.

sources.title: WCAG Technique G139
sources.locator: About; examples; procedure
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: A field-addressable error list can preserve entered data and route users to each error and back. The technique is advisory, not the sole method of meeting WCAG. Its example oracle is meaningful for the proposed keyboard recovery flow; no example was executed by this evaluator.

sources.title: UIA DataGrid Control Type
sources.locator: Required patterns; tree; properties and events
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: For UIA-integrated controls, Grid is required; Table, Selection and Scroll depend on headers and capabilities, with corresponding item patterns. Names, focus and structure events are part of the adapter contract. This does not certify an unspecified toolkit.

sources.title: UIA VirtualizedItem Provider
sources.locator: Implementation Guidelines; Realize
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: Realize updates a placeholder with full properties and patterns. Bringing it into view is optional; an offscreen realized item should support ScrollIntoView. A required realization mechanism and actual scrolling/focus are distinct steps.

sources.title: UIA Working with Virtualized Items
sources.locator: ItemContainer; FindItemByProperty; Realize; ScrollIntoView
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: ItemContainer locates placeholders, which may initially lack properties. Clients realize the returned item and explicitly scroll it if needed. This adjacent client context confirms why declarations of logical size cannot alone expose or operate unmaterialized records.

sources.title: AppKit NSAccessibilityTable
sources.version_context: Current public AppKit symbol documentation; no release pinned
sources.locator: Overview; required methods; rows, visible rows, headers and selection
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: Apple's public documentation data endpoint was readable independently. It defines a table-role protocol with rows/columns, visible elements, selected elements and headers, and explicit implementation requirements. This verifies the inherited conceptual claim, not the console's VoiceOver behavior. Candidate reviewers' reported retrieval limits are not rewritten.

sources.title: AT-SPI Table
sources.locator: get_n_rows/get_n_columns; cell lookup; headers; selection
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: Counts include off-viewport elements but exclude programmatically hidden rows/columns. Cell lookup uses logical coordinates; row/column selection is not supported by every table. These conditions do not prove that a custom virtual renderer exports appropriate accessible cells.

sources.title: AG Grid Accessibility
sources.locator: DOM order; full rendering; known limitations
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: The vendor recommends ordered DOM and pagination/full current-page rendering for its screen-reader workflow, balancing disabled virtualization against rendering cost. Focused-state updates and server-side row-count announcements have documented limitations. These are vendor conditions, not universal limits on virtual grids or a native library selection.

sources.title: AG Grid Row IDs
sources.locator: Row IDs; getRowId
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: The documented ID callback must consistently identify a row with a unique string. Stable row IDs support state tracking; names and current visual coordinates are unsuitable as durable domain identity.

sources.title: AG Grid Updating Row Data
sources.locator: ID comparison; How It Works; transactions
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: Selection preservation assumes the row exists in both snapshots. Immutable object/list changes guide updates; absent IDs remove rows and order may change. The mechanism is not durable edit storage. Transaction/batched update options provide additional scale context without being required features in this proposal.

sources.title: AG Grid Keyboard Navigation
sources.locator: Navigation; editing; header sorting; custom cells
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: Editable cells accept Enter/F2; headers support keyboard sort. Custom cell content needs its own keyboard navigation and may need grid-key suppression. Vendor bindings can differ from APG conventions, so a particular package requires adaptation and testing.

sources.title: MUI Accessibility
sources.locator: Row headers; tab sequence; tabNavigation; keyboard
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: Meaningful row headers identify records and remain mounted during horizontal virtualization. Custom renderers own inner tab-order management. Default Tab behavior and configurable modes differ. This supports distinct focus/selection and disambiguation without claiming cross-platform success.

sources.title: MUI Row Definition
sources.locator: Row identifier; references
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: Each row has a unique internal ID, with configurable getRowId, separate from displayed data. Stable function and array references avoid repeated work. The API does not choose privacy-safe human labels or provide external draft storage.

sources.title: MUI Editing Persistence
sources.locator: processRowUpdate; server-side validation
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: Rejecting an update promise retains editing; returning the original row exits editing without the update. Error callbacks and lifecycle hooks support validation. None guarantees draft survival after filtering, deletion or widget unmount.

sources.title: MUI v8 Virtualization
sources.version_context: Versioned v8 documentation; candidate finalizer records v8.29.3
sources.locator: row buffer; column overscan; autoHeight; dynamic height; disableVirtualization
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: The buffer is a hint; high-speed scrolling can override it. Horizontal overscan enables the next target. AutoHeight and dynamic-height conditions matter. Full disabling is costly. The 100-row wording concerns a component, not a product dataset cap; adjacent tagged pagination code narrows the community-product limit.

sources.title: MUI v8.29.3 Pagination Limit and Caller
sources.locator: MAX_PAGE_SIZE; throwIfPageSizeExceedsTheLimit; caller getDerivedPaginationModel
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: The 100-row page-size guard applies to the DataGrid signature and directs larger pages to Pro/Premium. The pagination-model caller invokes the guard. This rules out treating 100 as a total dataset or universal virtualization ceiling. A guessed virtual-scroller path returned 404 and supplied no evidence.

sources.title: TanStack Virtualization Guide
sources.version_context: Mutable latest; body explicitly describes v9 setup
sources.locator: Setup; client/server boundary; current row model
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: Table state and virtualizer measurement/index selection are separate. Client windowing still requires client data and does not perform server query operations. Rendering must use the current row/column model. The latest guide is not a frozen package API.

sources.title: TanStack v8 Row Selection
sources.locator: Useful Row Ids; manualPagination caveat
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: The default row ID is the input row index; getRowId supplies durable identity. Selection state may retain IDs absent from a manual page while the selected row model only materializes that page. The evaluator retrieved this page independently; prior retrieval failures remain historical facts about the candidate review.

sources.title: TanStack v8.21.3 Row-ID Definition and Core Caller
sources.locator: _getRowId; getCoreRowModel createRow caller
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: The default ID is generated from input index, with parent context for nested rows. The core row-model caller supplies the original input index. Sorting/filtering an unchanged input model does not itself reassign that index; external replacement and manual paging motivate the stronger domain-key recommendation.

sources.title: MUI Filter Focus Regression and Fix
sources.locator: maintainer comment; PR implementation and test
sources.observed_operation: Independently retrieved and read relevant primary context; adjacent code/test context where recorded.
sources.observation: The filter placeholder changed ID during rerenders after row updates. The merged patch holds it in a reference. Its regression test compares placeholder IDs before/after rows change and skips JSDOM because that environment does not rerender the panel correctly. This is transient filter-control identity, distinct from row IDs; it is not a current general MUI defect.

limitations: Finite claim-directed research, not universal recall or exhaustive correctness.
Physical assistive-technology interoperability and the future console were not tested.
A guessed MUI virtual-scroller source path was unavailable; the exact tagged pagination helper and caller were available and inspected.
Candidate read order, provider activity, account routing and native receipt freshness are not established by public source research.
